must: Use theme tokens for color, spacing, radius, typography and shadow
Keep Arabic as default and fallback
Keep OMR at three fractional digits
Expose accessible roles, labels and states on interactive controls
avoid: Pink outside badges and the brand gradient
Decorative gradients, glass effects and oversized headlines
Feature-specific data fetching in shared components

decisions.decision: Preserve the approved BRANDHUB reference direction and implement it as native React Native primitives.
decisions.reason: The project architecture and prototype already fix the visual direction; no redesign was requested.

decisions.decision: On the seller store, overlap the cover with the 68 pt store tile only; keep seller copy and actions wholly below the cover.
decisions.reason: The original shared-row overlap caused the store name, verification line, and follow action to straddle the hero boundary on device.

decisions.decision: Compact controls must render at their declared visual size and use hit slop only for the remainder of the 44 pt touch target.
decisions.reason: Using compactSize only in the hit-slop calculation collapsed icon buttons to the glyph size, making PDP and card wishlist actions visibly too small.
